name: create_k8s_deployment_probes
description: Authors a production-ready Kubernetes Deployment with probes, resource requests/limits and a non-root securityContext
prompts: Create a Kubernetes manifest at k8s/deployment.yaml defining a production-ready Deployment. Requirements: apiVersion apps/v1, kind Deployment, metadata.name `web`; spec.replicas 3; a pod template whose single container is named `web`, uses image `myorg/web:1.2.3`, and exposes containerPort 8080. The container must declare resources.requests AND resources.limits (each with both cpu and memory), a livenessProbe (httpGet path /healthz on port 8080) and a readinessProbe (httpGet path /ready on port 8080), and the pod or container securityContext must set runAsNonRoot: true. Make sure the Deployment selector.matchLabels matches the pod template labels.

test_setup_files.test_k8s.py:
import yaml

with open('k8s/deployment.yaml') as f:
    d = yaml.safe_load(f)

assert d.get('apiVersion') == 'apps/v1', d.get('apiVersion')
assert d.get('kind') == 'Deployment', d.get('kind')
assert d.get('metadata', {}).get('name') == 'web', 'metadata.name must be web'

spec = d['spec']
assert spec.get('replicas') == 3, f"replicas must be 3, got {spec.get('replicas')}"

match_labels = spec['selector']['matchLabels']
template = spec['template']
tpl_labels = template['metadata']['labels']
for k, v in match_labels.items():
    assert tpl_labels.get(k) == v, f'selector.matchLabels must match template labels: {k}={v!r} vs {tpl_labels.get(k)!r}'

containers = template['spec']['containers']
assert len(containers) >= 1
c = containers[0]
assert c['image'] == 'myorg/web:1.2.3', c.get('image')
ports = [p.get('containerPort') for p in c.get('ports', [])]
assert 8080 in ports, f'containerPort 8080 missing: {ports}'

res = c.get('resources', {})
for kind in ('requests', 'limits'):
    block = res.get(kind, {})
    assert block.get('cpu') and block.get('memory'), f'resources.{kind} must set cpu and memory, got {block!r}'

for probe in ('livenessProbe', 'readinessProbe'):
    hg = (c.get(probe) or {}).get('httpGet')
    assert hg and hg.get('path'), f'{probe} must be an httpGet with a path'

pod_sc = template['spec'].get('securityContext') or {}
c_sc = c.get('securityContext') or {}
assert pod_sc.get('runAsNonRoot') is True or c_sc.get('runAsNonRoot') is True, 'runAsNonRoot: true must be set'

print('PASS')

reference_solution.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: myorg/web:1.2.3
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 128Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 256Mi
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8080
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
              port: 8080
